name: @ra/cluster-formula
description: RAW AROMACHEM formula vault cluster (formula schema): the formula-IP crown jewel. CRUD over formula type/master/version, access policy, document mapping; the seal flow (material_id + percentage sealed at rest with a per-formula DEK, AES-256-GCM envelope, KEK via KmsPort); approval/lock + copy-request lifecycle; a HASH-CHAINED access audit written in the same transaction as every decrypt; and the FORMULA_LOOKUP port exposing only the ALIAS-masked floor view (real material_id never leaves the cluster). Owns its own ra_vault Drizzle client (own connection seam → in-house DB later).
